questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

Rita was a model so she would starve herself to maintain their body weight.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is '**their body weight'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

In this part of the sentence, the usage of **'their'** is incorrect Instead, use** 'her'**

As the subject of the sentence is singular hence we need to use the singular pronoun for this i.e. 'Her'. The subject of the sentence is 'Rita' also the verb is 'was' a model is a subject complement.

**So the correct sentence is-** *Rita was a model so she would starve herself to maintain **her** body weight.*

questions.question: Among 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F, it is known that; A is taller than at-least 3 persons. C is taller than B, who is taller than exactly 1 person. D is not shorter than C. E is taller than A and D is shorter than A. Who is 4th shortest person among all?
questions.solution:
6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F

1. A is taller than at-least 3 persons.

A > _ > _ > _ (Atleast)

2. C is taller than B, who is taller than exactly 1 person.

_ > _ > _ > C > B > _

3. D is not shorter than C.

D > C

4. E is taller than A and D is shorter than A.

E > A > D

Combining all the statements together, we get:

E > A > D > C > B > _

Only F is left, so it will take the vacant position.

So, the final arrangement is:

E > A > D > C > B > F

Hence, D is the 4th shortest person among all

questions.question: If in a certain way, 3 + 4 = 25 and 7 + 24 = 625, then find 9 + 40 = ?
questions.solution:
The pattern is:

3 + 4 = 25 → 3² + 4² = 25

7 + 24 = 625 → 7² + 24² = 625

Similarly,

9 + 40 = → 9² + 40² = 81 + 1600 = **1681**

Hence, ‘1681’ is the correct answer

questions.question:
Study the following information carefully and answer the questions given below.

(i) Eight boys P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a circular table.

(ii) P and Q are sitting opposite to each other.

(iii) S is sitting second to the right of P and V is sitting second to the right of Q.

(iv) T and W are sitting opposite to each other.

(v) R is sitting between P and V.

What is the position of T with respect to Q?
questions.solution:
(i) Eight boys P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a circular table.

As no information is given regarding which direction are these eight persons facing, we consider all of them are facing inside the circle.

(ii) P and Q are sitting opposite to each other.

(iv) T and W are sitting opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a9572bd744fc6c3cc96756fab402549d855be358a6332a9119f04c62514d078.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d76e4c82e1f7d628ce732659476e2b1929385f8d5a9ea755719ae4682e66138.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c0865fc0c994b5eb24d8163a055b6b361dc74284946be209438d89ee63b8827.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/707a1bd833396449f3b4cc656d8f7675fd56923541015cb60f8cd22cfa455a86.png] 

The position of T with respect to Q – there can be two answers:

1 - T is third to the left of Q (From Case I)

2 – T is immediate right of Q (From Case II) – But no such option is given

So, we consider the answer that comes from Case I.

Hence, T is third to the left of Q

questions.question: In physics, what is the Hubble constant?

questions.solution:
Option **4** is correct, i.e. __**Unit of measurement that explains the expansion of the universe**__.

 
• American astronomer **Edwin Hubble** (the space telescope was named after him) measured the speed of galaxies and their distance from Earth and obtained the graph.
 
• Hubble's law is a statement of
 a direct correlation between the distance to a galaxy and its recessional velocity as determined by the redshift. It can be stated as:
 
• **v=Hₒd**, In the equation, v is the velocity of a receding galaxy, d is the distance to the galaxy, and Hₒ is the Hubble's constant.
 
• **Hubble's constant** is approximately **2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ S****⁻¹** if the distance is in meters and the speed in meters per second.

questions.question: Which Indian founded the Natal Indian Congress (NIC)?
questions.solution:
Option **2** is correct, i.e. __**Mahatma Gandhi**__.

__
 
• In **1894,** Mahatma Gandhi__ founded the **Natal Indian Congress**, of which he himself became an indefatigable secretary.
 
• The Natal Indian Congress (NIC) was an organization formed to fight the discrimination faced by Indians in South Africa.
 
• Gandhi was the first Honorary Secretary of the Congress.
 
• This organization went on to lead many non-violent protests in the cause of discrimination faced not just by Indians but also by native Africans.
